mentions.name: Terragon Labs
mentions.description: Terragon Labs orchestrates Claude Code and other AI coding agents (Amp, Codex) as background agents in a remote environment, letting users run multiple agents on different tasks without locally switching between them.
mentions.problem: The author is constantly bouncing between different agents locally for different tasks and wanted the same capability in a remote environment.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently I've been working on https://terragonlabs.com which is a way to orchestrate Claude Code and other agents (Amp, Codex) as background agents.
